model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Viggle Turbo v0.2.1 · 6 Steps
model.description: Viggle's six-step distilled Qwen Image 2.1 for text-to-image and instruction editing with up to three input images. INT8 ConvRot base plus the official rank-256 LoRA at runtime. Preview release; complex edits may be less faithful than the 40-step base.
model.selector_help: Uses the official v0.2.1 six-step sigma schedule, CFG 1 and LoRA strength 1. The base transformer, text encoder and VAE are shared with Qwen Image 2.1 INT8; first use downloads an additional ~1.4 GB adapter. Start at 1K. 2K, RGBA and masked edits are not validated by Viggle. Do not stack another acceleration LoRA. Non-commercial Qwen Research License.

resource_requirements.note: Reuses the Qwen 2.1 base files; adapter adds memory overhead. Use encoder offload on 24 GB GPUs.
